messages.content: 需要多長時間來塗漆艾菲爾鐵塔？

function.name: get_case_result
function.description: Retrieve the result of a specific law case based on the year and name of the case. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_year.description: The year when the law case was established.

case_name.description: The name of the law case.

message.content: 艾菲爾鐵塔（Eiffel Tower）每隔七年左右會進行一次大規模的維護與重新塗漆。根據官方資料，整個塗漆工程通常需要約兩週左右完成。這段時間內，工人會先對鐵塔表面進行清潔、打磨，然後塗上防銹底漆，再塗上多層保護漆。雖然整個過程只需兩週，但在此之前還會進行前期準備工作，例如拆卸部分裝飾物、檢查結構安全等，整體維護周期（包括準備、施工和恢復）可能會延伸到數月。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "需要多長時間來塗漆艾菲爾鐵塔？" which translates to "How long does it take to paint the Eiffel Tower?" They want an estimate. This is not a request for a law case. So no function call. Just answer. Provide approximate time, maybe referencing known data: painting schedule, frequency, maintenance. Provide context: The Eiffel Tower is painted every 7 years, takes about 2 weeks to paint. Or mention that painting takes about 2 weeks, but the tower is painted every 7 years. Provide details.
